description: p7's input with `Presented_as: "delivery"` added beside `presented_as: "delivery"`. Member names compare as exact strings, so `Presented_as` is a name phase_claim does not define and the record rejects with unknown_member_reject. p7 is the accepting twin. An engine that compares names without regard to letter case reads the two as one member and accepts this vector. Rests on `defined_members` in MANIFEST.json.
